semiconductor_relevance: High — LNEYA specializes in temperature control devices crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: LNEYA Thermo Refrigeration Co., Ltd. focuses on the design and production of advanced temperature control systems, particularly chillers, for the semiconductor industry. Their products offer precise temperature control across a wide range, supporting critical processes such as wafer etching and reaction chamber temperature management.
capabilities: Peltier chiller thermoelectric cooler for plasma etching applications
Ultra-low temperature refrigeration technology from -100°C to -80°C
